projects.title: Nexus AI Orchestrator
projects.tagline: Multi-Agent Autonomous Workflow Engine with Real-Time Observability
projects.description: An enterprise-grade autonomous agent platform orchestrating LLM chains, tool invocations, distributed worker tasks, and automated failover pipelines with streaming telemetry.
projects.architectureDetails: Event-driven pub/sub architecture built atop Redis Streams and WebSocket workers, serving low-latency interactive agent chat and autonomous task execution.

projects.title: CyberVault Zero-Trust Storage
projects.tagline: End-to-End Encrypted Cloud Storage & Decentralized Key Management
projects.description: A zero-knowledge cryptographic cloud drive utilizing client-side AES-256-GCM encryption, granular IAM access control lists, and instant chunked uploads.
projects.architectureDetails: Client-side key derivation via Argon2id, cryptographic chunk hashing, and presigned multipart S3 pipelines with automated virus scanning.

projects.title: HyperMetric Real-Time Telemetry
projects.description: A full-stack monitoring and alerting dashboard capable of ingesting 50,000+ metric data points/sec with customizable Grafana-style drag-and-drop widgets.
projects.architectureDetails: Time-series hypertable partitioning, sliding window aggregation queries, and dynamic SVG chart renderers with auto-downsampling.

projects.title: SynthWave CLI & Developer Toolchain
projects.tagline: Cross-Platform Developer CLI for Instant Microservice Scaffolding
projects.description: A high-performance command line tool powering automated repository bootstrapping, CI/CD pipeline synthesis, and container security audits.
projects.architectureDetails: Modular plugin architecture with native Rust bindings, interactive curses terminal interface, and zero-config deployment generators.

projects.title: Pulse Web3 & Fiat SuperApp
projects.tagline: Next-Gen Mobile-First Cross-Border Payments & Staking Wallet
projects.description: Seamless cross-border payment application combining instant biometric authentication, multi-currency ledger, and real-time conversion rates.
projects.architectureDetails: Optimistic UI state synchronization, biometric key store integration, and resilient offline queueing with exponential backoff.

projects.title: Aura Cyber Design System
projects.tagline: Accessible, Accessible Dark-First UI Component Library & Token Suite
projects.description: A comprehensive enterprise design kit featuring 60+ accessible cyber-styled UI components, tokens, micro-interactions, and sound synthesizers.
projects.metrics: 100% WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant • Zero Runtime Overhead
projects.architectureDetails: Atomic token architecture, compound component patterns, keyboard accessibility primitives, and polymorphic ref forwarding.
